channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: After Red Sea losses, Yemen’s government forces hold the line
item.description: Air strikes and difficult terrain have prevented the Houthis from turning coastal gains into a wider breakthrough.

item.title: Saudi-led coalition says power station attacked in Medina, blames Houthis
item.description: At the same time in Yemen, the Saudi-backed government army says it is inflicting heavy losses on the Houthis in Taiz.

item.title: British police arrest UK-Iranian national over airbase incident
item.description: Counter Terrorism police also questioned a UK national, days after five others were arrested and released on bail.

item.title: UK PM Burnham says Iran likely behind RAF base incident: Is there evidence?
item.description: UK, US and Israeli officials point to Iranian involvement but remain tight-lipped on details.

item.title: Netanyahu says Flydubai attacker had 'Islamist radical indoctrination'
item.description: Israel's prime minister says the pilot who tried to take over the Flydubai plane clearly intended to "down the plane".

item.title: Renee Good: Family of US woman killed by ICE agent sues Trump officials
item.description: Lawyers for Good's family say US officials created "an unprecedented environment for state sponsored violence" in Minneapolis.

item.title: Who is the 'hero' Indian pilot who was stabbed on Israel-bound flight?
item.description: Capt Smit Machchhar was attacked by another pilot onboard the Flydubai flight bound for Tel Aviv.

item.title: Inside India's forest villages, where a dangerous mix of crises led to 32 child deaths
item.description: At least 32 children have died in India's Balaghat district since May amid outbreaks of measles and malaria.

item.title: Flydubai passenger describes putting attacker in chokehold after cockpit stabbing
item.description: Other passengers on the Israel-bound flight described the "terrifying" moment the plane dropped.

item.title: Plummeting Israel flight like 'rollercoaster', says passenger
item.description: An aeroplane flying to Israel fell 17,000ft (5,200m) in less than two minutes before it was diverted.
